verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly list 'region' as one of the parameters you choose when creating a machine, giving users control over where compute (and associated storage) is provisioned. However there is no broader documentation on data residency guarantees, compliance certifications, or where backups/shared drives are stored relative to chosen region. missing for 10: explicit data-residency/compliance documentation, confirmation that storage (backups, shared drives) stays within the selected region.
